Health conditionGood physical and mental health (free from infectious diseases and physical or mental disorders that may affect normal study).2 Age requirementAs of September 1, 2025, applicants must not exceed 25 years old.3 Educational requirementsBy September 1, 2025, applicants must have obtained a high school graduation certificate.4 Learning abilityApplicants should possess good learning ability and academic performance. The score requirement for applicants of the undergraduate program in the previous application stage is 75%. Schools refer to the results of internationally recognized standardized tests such as SAT, ACT, A-Level, AP, IB, and GED, or regional high school unified examinations. Applicants may provide proof of other learning abilities or academic performance.5 Language requirementsApplicants should have a language proficiency in Chinese or English that meets the admission standards. In some countries, the proof of English proficiency may be waived (information on English-speaking countries).
